name: Obscure Affairs
source: Obscure Affairs is about you, and only you! Going through some rough times, a failed marriage which lasted a few years and ended up in a night, but some time after you managed to get over it and start over, this time from zero, and hope you get back those years of youth which you lost, and somehow you managed to do that, but we'll see how that goes...
translation: 《Obscure Affairs》講述的是你的故事，而且只屬於你！你曾經歷一段艱難的日子，一場持續數年的失敗婚姻，在一夜之間結束。不過，過了一段時間，你終於走了出來，決定重新開始。這一次從零起步，希望找回那些失去的青春歲月。你還真以某種方式做到了，但接下來會怎樣，且看故事發展……
